newsitem.title: CANADA: Revenue to issue C$65 mln of debentures.
newsitem.headline: Revenue to issue C$65 mln of debentures.

text.p: Revenue Properties Company Ltd said on Wednesday it agreed to issue C$65 million of unsecured convertible debentures.
The real estate company said the agreement included an option to increase the offering by up to $20 million on the same terms.

The 7.0 percent debentures mature on December 31, 2006 and pay interest semi-annually. The company said the debentures would be convertible into common shares of the company at the option of the holder any time before redemption or maturity.
